connector.name: Fiscal
connector.registryDescription: Brazilian fiscal MCP server - issue NF-e, NFC-e, NFS-e, CT-e, MDF-e and DC-e via SEFAZ.
connector.summary: Hosted at api.brasilnfe.com.br over streamable HTTP. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace br.com.brasilnfe, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer TOKEN da empresa. Obtenha no painel em https://api.brasilnfe.com.br
